title: The Export Wave Is Cresting
gist: China's extraordinary export boom is leveling off, with headline YoY growth stuck around 24-27% (USD terms) for three months; memory chips are now the key swing factor, and Gavekal expects total 2027 export growth to converge toward the non-AI trend of 5-7% as chip price gains fade.

insights.claim: China's headline export YoY growth has leveled off over the past three months, holding around 24-27% in US dollar terms and 18-20% in renminbi terms, signaling the extraordinary export wave is cresting.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A plateau in export growth after a surge is an early signal to watch for deceleration in China's external demand contribution to GDP.
insights.quote: The headline YoY growth of exports has leveled off over the past three months, staying around 24-27% in US dollar terms and 18-20% in renminbi terms.
insights.locator: China's latest extraordinary export wave is showing signs of cresting

insights.claim: The boom in China's exports of AI-investment-related products is not over, but current super-high growth rates will probably slow in coming months.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Investors positioned for continued acceleration in China's AI-linked export names should expect deceleration rather than a further step-up from here.
insights.locator: The boom in exports of products associated with investment in artificial intelligence

themes.theme: Memory chips as the swing factor

insights.claim: Memory chips have become the single biggest swing factor for China's export growth, and prices for some memory products have recently leveled off after a massive surge.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Memory chip pricing (e.g., DRAM/NAND) is now a key macro tell for China's export headline numbers, not just a sector-specific data point.
insights.quote: Memory chips are now the biggest single swing factor for exports, and prices for some products have recently leveled off after their massive surge.
insights.locator: Memory chips are now the biggest single swing factor

insights.claim: Gavekal expects total Chinese export growth in 2027 to converge toward the recent non-AI trend of around 5-7%, as the memory-price-driven surge fades, while semiconductor cycles have limited implications for China's broader, still-competitive export base.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A base case of 5-7% export growth for 2027 sets an explicit benchmark against which to judge future China trade data surprises.
insights.quote: growth of total exports in 2027 will most likely converge toward the recent trend for products outside the AI complex, which is around 5-7%
insights.locator: growth of total exports in 2027 will most likely converge
